feeds.title: Scott H. Young Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Scott H Young. I'm a Wall Street Journal bestselling author, podcast host, computer programmer, and avid reader. Since 2006, I've published weekly essays on this website to help people like you learn and think better. The theme of posts ranges from productivity to learning to the meaning of life.

feeds.title: Roli Edema Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Roli, a Nigerian-British girl, and editor-in-chief of this personal development website. On this site, you'll usually find me sharing insights on various personal development topics, books, and online learning recommendations. I am to inspire, inform and engage readers from all over the world who are interested in improving their skills, developing their careers, overcoming obstacles, and upgrading their mindset.

feeds.title: John WhiteHead Blog
feeds.description: A blog dealing with Leadership, interpersonal communications, and team building. John K. Whitehead & Associates was formed in 2014 to provide coaching to both individuals and organizations who are interested in exploring how to improve the way they communicate, understand, and work with each other.

feeds.title: Tidbits of Care
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Giulia.I write a lifestyle blog that seeks to inspire others to begin to their own journey into self care, one tidbit at a time. I am passionate about sharing my own journey from the last decade, and what I've learned along the way. If you are interested in living a more authentic life, balancing your life and work, and looking to grow as an individual, you'll feel right at home here.

feeds.title: Possibility Change
feeds.description: Welcome! My name is Peter and I'm the Founder and Editor of Possibility Change. Since 2007, Possibility Change blog features over one thousand stories related to personal change with inspiration and practical actions to change your life.

feeds.title: Trisha Passion Igniter Blog
feeds.description: Passion Igniter's blog by Trisha Miltimore is on leadership, personal development, and team engagement. Basically how to be an impactful totally awesome human. Trisha Miltimore is an International Speaker empowering teams, leaders, and HUMANS to engineer their own deeply satisfying life experience.

feeds.title: Productivityist Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Productivityist - a company built with the quest to help you define your day, filter your focus, and make every moment matter. We do this through a variety of resources designed to help you craft your time in a sustainable way, leading to a more balanced and fulfilling life. The company was founded by yours truly - writer, speaker, and productivity strategist Mike Vardy - and he continues to be the main driving force behind both the website and the company.

feeds.title: Growth Guided
feeds.description: GrowthGuided.com is a website devoted to psychology, empowerment, and culture. We publish feature articles, links to things we find interesting online, podcasts, videos, and comics created by the Growth Guided editorial team and other invited contributors. This site was created with the intention to empower you to your next step in life. The content gathered for this site is here to liberate you and maybe even challenge you a little bit.

feeds.title: Transformational Change Blog
feeds.description: Susan is a successful mindset coach and mentor who uses a proven process 'Thinking into result' and is a certified consultant with the Proctor Gallagher Institute. She brings a depth of knowledge and a thorough understanding of the mind, spirit, and body connection. Sign up to hear from her about new blog posts regarding your personal development, goal setting, and your self improvement plan.

feeds.title: Bosie International Blog
feeds.description: My name is Gail Scott, and I run Bosie International. I bring effective solutions to everyday human issues through increased self-awareness, improved ways to communicate, and a deeper understanding of yourself and others.

feeds.title: Hina Khan Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Hina Khan. As a peak performance coach and registered psychotherapist (inactive), I have been a student of the mind, human behavior, and human potential for over a decade. What you can expect from me is someone who will help you challenge and explore the thoughts and beliefs that hold you back.

feeds.title: Lisa Jeffs Blog
feeds.description: My name is Lisa Jeffs, your Intuitive Toronto Life Coach & Career Coach. Being an Intuitive Toronto Life Coach, I'm passionate about helping dedicated individuals create massive transformations in their lives and career. Looking for business advice or entrepreneurial inspiration? Read my helpful articles or watch my videos to find the information you need.
